words.gloss: to those who do not understand

literal: Do not complain of the pain suffered to those who do not understand; do not show weakness in the presence of enemies.
translation: Do not complain of your suffering to those who cannot understand it, and do not reveal your weakness in the presence of your enemies.
modern: தன் துன்பத்தை உணராதவர்களிடம் அதற்காக வருந்திப் பேசக் கூடாது; பகைவர்களிடத்தில் தன் பலவீனத்தைக் காட்டிக் கொள்ளக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet offers practical wisdom on maintaining personal strength and strategic caution. First, it advises against sharing one's pain (நொந்தது) with people who lack the empathy or capacity to understand it (அறியார்க்கு), as doing so is futile and only invites pity or contempt. Second, it warns against showing any vulnerability or weakness (மென்மை) in front of enemies (பகைவர் அகத்து). By keeping one's suffering private and maintaining a strong front, one prevents adversaries from finding a point of vulnerability to exploit.
